Caption Track Review
A media element can declare a record of what is said and a translation of it. They are different facts, and a bundle that stored them alike would let a translation be quoted as the source.

Caption Track Review
Training video
The walkthrough covers the capture workflow end to end and is captioned in English for accessibility.

Audio briefing
The audio briefing summarizes the quarter in four minutes; a German subtitle track accompanies it.

Quarterly training video — video transcript, part 1 of 1
Welcome to the quarterly capture workflow review.
Every page element you see becomes part of the record.

Operations audio briefing — audio on this page, NOT transcribed
This media is NOT transcribed. It declares track(s), but none of them is kind="captions" — what it has is a translation rather than a transcription of what is said. The text is kept and named in the manifest as a translation, and is deliberately not inlined into content.md, so nothing downstream can retrieve it as though it were the source.
